name: Exponential quantum advantage for learning signals with a single qubit
description: Quantum technology has the potential to transform scientific discovery, but quantum advantages often require processing capabilities well beyond the reach of experimental platforms. We show that coupling a single controllable qubit to an otherwise conventional sensor can exponentially reduce the number of measurements required to learn classical signals. These rigorous quantum advantages apply to fundamental sensing tasks, including learning Fourier coefficients, extracting temporal correlations

analysis.en: Exponential Quantum Advantage studies the capability of a single qubit in learning classical signals, demonstrating the potential of quantum technology.

zh.why: 通过将单个可控量子比特耦合到传统传感器上，可以显著减少学习经典信号所需的测量次数。
zh.biz: 这一研究展示了量子技术在信号处理领域的巨大潜力。

en.what: Exponential Quantum Advantage studies the exponential advantage of a single qubit in learning classical signals.
en.why: By coupling a single controllable qubit to a conventional sensor, the number of measurements required to learn classical signals can be significantly reduced.
en.biz: This research demonstrates the great potential of quantum technology in signal processing.

name: Vero: Can AI Agents Build Formally Verified Software Repositories?
description: AI agents are increasingly used for programming, but do not provide any guarantee on the correctness of generated code. Verified code generation, in which an agent produces both an implementation and a machine-checked proof of its specification, offers a stronger path toward trustworthy AI-generated software. name: LittleLearner: Language Models Under Pedagogically Controlled Knowledge Exposure
description: Modern language models are trained on heterogeneous web-scale text corpora. Consequently, studying knowledge and skill acquisition is difficult, as prior exposure to related content is hard to characterize. To address this challenge, we introduce LITTLECURRICULUM, a curated 88B-token pretraining corpus tailored to U.S. elementary school material, explicitly excluding concepts, facts, and vocabulary taught above Grade 5. Training a 5B-parameter LLM from scratch on LITTLECURRICULUM yields LITTLELE
reason: LittleLearner 提出了一种在教育控制下暴露知识的语言模型。

analysis.zh: LittleLearner 提出了一种在教育控制下暴露知识的语言模型，使用了专门为美国小学材料定制的预训练语料库。
analysis.en: LittleLearner introduces a language model under pedagogically controlled knowledge exposure, using a curated pretraining corpus tailored to U.S. elementary school material.

name: Alaya-EVOKE: From Linear-Scaling Supervision to Endless World
description: Interactive world models must support persistent memory, responsive interaction, and long-horizon generation, yet these requirements place conflicting demands on the model. Maintaining history in the denoiser context or key-value cache incurs growing cost, forcing a trade-off between session length and retained memory, while low-latency interaction relies on few-step generation whose capabilities are bounded by its teacher. Evoke addresses both limitations by externalizing persistent world state
reason: 一个持久记忆和交互式世界模型，支持长时序生成和低延迟交互。

zh.biz: 该模型可以应用于虚拟现实、游戏和模拟训练等领域，具有较高的商业价值。

Diffusion-based drafters further reduce proposal latency by predicting an entire token block in parallel, but their position-wise distributions are marginal rather than conditioned on tokens selected along each draft path. Kinematic errors average per-frame pose differences but miss the physical artifacts that matter most, particularly unstable support and incorrect contacts such as foot skating and mistimed touch-downs.
